text:
Elena: Heads-up 3: partner (cloud+HW combo) sent a draft private offer tied to a co-branded product announcement on Sept 30. They want a price-lock for 12 months post-launch and guaranteed capacity for first 60 days. Need fast alignment on risk + announcement gating.

Jonah: Two separate asks: (1) operational guarantee for 60d, (2) commercial price-lock. We can do a limited price collar but cap it (max 8% protection) and make it contingent on meeting consumption milestones + signed LOI within 30d after term.

Priya: Ops impact: guaranteed capacity -> we need per-offer soft-reserved slots, not hard pins. Hard pins hurt other tenants. Propose `soft_reserve_pct` + `priority_window_days` fields and explicit circuit-breaker if cluster saturation >75%.

Marco: Also add a pacing schedule in the offer JSON: `ramp_plan=[{"day_range":"0-14","pct":30},{"day_range":"15-30","pct":60},{"day_range":"31-60","pct":100}]` so partner can't push full traffic day 1. We should require monitor hooks and an automated fallback to public models when thresholds exceed.

Tara (Legal): For price-lock clause: we can provide a capped collar (<=8%) but require: (a) consumption >= 50% of committed value by day 60 OR (b) signed renewal LOI within 30 days. Otherwise collar void. Also draft embargo language: no public announcement until Redwood confirms capacity for first 14 days post-launch.

Elena: Partner wants SI onboarding credits upfront to accelerate integrations for the joint launch. Strong preference to tranche credits: 30% on signed agreement, 40% on first two customers go-live, 30% after 90d verification. Credits non-transferable and expire 12 months after issuance.

Jonah: Finance insists on holding a 3% security credit until day 45 post-launch if they want upfront SI credits. Also prefer post-pay billing for visibility.

ops-bot: Query run: ```sql
SELECT offer_id, committed_usd, used_30d, planned_launch FROM mp_private_offers WHERE partner='cloud-hw-co' ORDER BY updated_ts DESC LIMIT 1;
```
Result: offer_id=chc-2026-09, committed_usd=2500000, used_30d=600000, planned_launch='2026-09-30'

Marco: used_30d=600k -> a high early burn. Ramp + soft reserve needed. Also require `fallback_model_policy` in offer: which public model(s) to switch to and throttling rules. Add automated banner in Console when fallback engaged.

Priya: Ops asks for an announcement gating checklist: capacity check (headroom >= 25%), runbook executed, throttle & fallback tested, SI credits escrow set, and legal redline accepted. No announcement until checklist true.

Tara (Legal): Add audit and dispute clause: Redwood telemetry is the source of truth; partner gets weekly usage reports and a 14-day dispute window. Escrow/refund language: prefer credits to cash refunds; non-consumed commitment converts to account credit based on thresholds.

Elena: Partner also requested a co-marketing press release date fixed; they want a 72h window to make last-minute activation changes. We should avoid accepting ad-hoc sudden activation. Propose activation notice requirement: `activation_notice_days=7` and allow `emergency_override` only with exec approval.

Jonah: Recommendation summary:
- Price collar capped at 8% and conditional on consumption or LOI
- Soft reserve + ramp_plan + activation_notice_days=7
- SI credits tranching + 3% security hold if upfront
- Escrow/credit policy: unused <=25% -> account credit; >25% -> marketing credit non-transferable
- Circuit-breaker: Dedicated_saturation>75% for 2h triggers auto-fallback + ops paging

Tara (Legal): I'll draft 3 short contract snippets: price collar, announcement embargo, SI credit tranching. Will include sample JSON fields: `soft_reserve_pct`, `ramp_plan`, `activation_notice_days`, `fallback_model_policy`, `price_collar_pct`, `si_credit_schedule`.

Priya: Ops action items: implement console banner for `fallback_engaged`, per-offer burn-rate panel, and add a pre-launch "capacity smoke test" flag. ETA? 10 dev-days for minimal UI + alerting.

Elena: Action items:
- Tara: legal snippets and embargo language (EOD)
- Priya: smoke-test runbook and ETA (tomorrow)
- Marco: author ramp_plan template and sample fallback policy (tomorrow)
- Jonah: finance terms for security hold + billing cadence (EOD)
- Elena: schedule partner alignment call Fri 8am PT and circulate checklist

ops-bot: Reminder: planned autoscaler maintenance 03:15 UTC Thu may reduce Dedicated headroom for ~25m; avoid major activation during that window.

Marco: Also adding a subtle note: require a "post-launch 14-day review" with partner to evaluate consumption patterns and adjust renewal terms. Include this as a contractual checkpoint.

Elena: Perfect. We'll push the counter with the above guardrails and refuse any hard-cap capacity guarantees. Thank you all. :white_check_mark:
